if: the value of the supply cannot be determined under s.15(1)
then: the value is determined in such manner as may be PRESCRIBED — that is, by the CGST Rules, not by s.15 itself
note: This is where a related-party supply, or a supply where price is not the sole consideration, goes. BLOCKED IN PRACTICE: the prescribed valuation rules are in the CGST Rules, which are not extracted here. Engine 3 must escalate rather than substitute a number.

evidence.quote: Where the value of the supply of goods or services or both cannot be determined under sub-section (1), the same shall be determined in such manner as may be prescribed.
